our_interpretation: Read as a tentative but testable assessment of capabilities available when the post appeared, not a forecast or conditional claim.
The plain reading of 'take in' in this comprehension-challenge context is understanding a complete episode sufficiently to answer substantive questions, rather than merely accepting its video file.
Use April 2, 2025 as the capability snapshot because 'as yet' refers to the post date. There is no natural quarterly reporting period for this observation.
Read 'often hallucinate heavily' as recurring, substantial invented details that impair comprehension. The speaker supplies no numerical frequency or accuracy threshold.
Read 'in real time' as tracking deception and motives as the story unfolds, without using later plot information.
The surrounding discussion calls for evaluating understanding from viewing, with safeguards against answers reproduced from prior exposure or online reviews.
criteria.support_condition: Reproducible evaluations of the systems available at the post date show limited correct comprehension, recurring substantial fabrications on complete Simpsons episodes, and failure to track deception and motives across all four Succession seasons as viewing proceeds.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Reproducible evaluations show that a system available at the post date reliably comprehends complete Simpsons episodes without recurring substantial fabrications, or successfully tracks who deceives whom and why across all four Succession seasons as viewing proceeds. Success on only one component would contradict that component, not automatically settle the others.

evidence.explanation: This is material counterevidence to reading 'take in' as video input capacity. The announcement describes frame-based processing without audio and does not establish reliable Simpsons comprehension or real-time Succession tracking.

HourVideo reports a substantial comprehension gap between Gemini 1.5 Pro and human experts on long egocentric videos. Different content, multiple-choice questions and an earlier model prevent it from settling the stated television-comprehension claim.

evidence.excerpt: a widespread susceptibility to hallucination issues
evidence.explanation: The evaluated models include Gemini 1.5 Pro, providing relevant evidence of hallucination problems. Adversarial yes/no questions and a 128-frame cap do not measure frequent heavy fabrication during complete-episode comprehension by the models available in April 2025.

The announcement states that Gemini 2.5 Pro was available in AI Studio and to Gemini Advanced users. Tests of Gemini 1.5 alone therefore cannot establish the capabilities of the available Gemini family at the post date.

public_payload.what_would_resolve: A reproducible evaluation of preserved model versions available on April 2, 2025, using complete Simpsons episodes and all four Succession seasons, with independently scored comprehension, fabricated details, deception tracking and response timing, plus controls against prior plot knowledge.
